title: Hardening: differential fuzzing, a regression suite, and the training gate
purpose: Fuzz the old and new math and code verifiers against the strict reference verifiers; every disagreement is a finding, and every confirmed false positive becomes a permanent regression case. Then apply the training gate to each verifier and write the registry, and try to pin a verifier the gate did not approve for training.

steps.display: vq.py job fuzz-static -- fuzz --verifiers math-final-answer@1.0.0,math-final-answer@2.0.0,code-tests@1.0.0,code-tests@2.0.0 --policy-samples none --out fuzz/static
aws s3 cp s3://<bucket>/fuzz/static/report.json -   # per verifier
vq.py job rg-math-final-answer-1-0-0 -- regress --verifier math-final-answer@1.0.0 --cases fuzz/static/regressions.jsonl
vq.py job rg-math-final-answer-2-0-0 -- regress --verifier math-final-answer@2.0.0 --cases fuzz/static/regressions.jsonl
vq.py job rg-code-tests-1-0-0 -- regress --verifier code-tests@1.0.0 --cases fuzz/static/regressions.jsonl
vq.py job rg-code-tests-2-0-0 -- regress --verifier code-tests@2.0.0 --cases fuzz/static/regressions.jsonl

checks.description: the old verifiers have false positives on every exploit family the design lists
checks.because: Each mutation is a known exploit; the reference rejects it and the old verifier accepts it.

checks.description: the new verifiers have no false positives and do not reject the equivalent forms the fuzzer must see accepted
checks.because: Strict contracts in the new versions; differential testing confirms them against an independent implementation.

checks.description: the gate approves the new math and code verifiers and rejects the old ones, naming the failed checks
checks.because: Precision lower bound, abstention, fuzzing false-positive rate and the regression suite, all from stored evidence.

checks.description: the audit and evaluation verifiers are registered for their own purpose only
checks.because: Each class declares its purpose and owner; the gate refuses anything that is not a training verifier.

checks.description: a training run can pin neither the evaluation verifier nor a rejected one (exit 3 both times)
checks.because: pinned() checks purpose and status in the registry, and the code hash of the running service.
